releases.title: Fixes the first start on Linux
notes: Electron is downloaded during install, not on the first start
A start that fails now prints why, instead of just pointing at a log file

Share your whole desktop as one code: bro export and bro import
Wallpapers ease off on battery and pause below 20%
Control Center shows what the wallpaper is costing right now
Your own photo drifts and leans towards the pointer
Install with one command on Windows and Linux

notes: Liquid pack: Koi Pond, Ink in Water, Chrome Blobs and Soap Bubble
Earthrise: the real Earth seen from the Moon
Lower CPU and GPU use on every wallpaper

releases.title: The first release of Mirage

Widgets, a dock, Spotlight search and a local AI assistant
17 themes, each with a light and a dark look
